environment.description: Rails 7.1 application deployed on EC2 (Amazon Linux 2023, x86_64). The libcrypto_bridge.so is compiled with gcc -O2 (no stack protector, no ASLR via personality flag on process). The native library loads key material from a local PKCS#12 file mounted at /etc/keys/keystore.p12. The decrypt_payload function copies the resolved key into a 256-byte stack buffer using memcpy with the actual key length (no bounds check). Application runs as root. No seccomp or AppArmor profile applied. ASLR disabled via 'echo 0 > /proc/sys/kernel/randomize_va_space' in the container entrypoint for deterministic performance.
